name: How long does bathroom flooring installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom flooring installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A straightforward bathroom flooring project often takes **one to three days**, but that can stretch longer if the subfloor needs leveling, drying, or repair. Smaller bathrooms with simple layouts move faster, while older homes or bathrooms with water damage usually take extra time. Scheduling also depends on material availability and whether demolition is included.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most jobs take 1–3 days, but repairs or moisture issues can extend that. Bigger or older bathrooms often need more time than a simple swap-out.
